question: Samsung Electronics parent company owner
markdown:
Samsung Electronics is a flagship subsidiary of the Samsung Group, controlled by the founding Lee family, currently led by Lee Jae-yong. It is publicly traded and headquartered in Suwon, South Korea, with cross-shareholdings among affiliates maintaining family control.
Samsung Electronics is a flagship subsidiary of the Samsung Group chaebol (conglomerate).
Ultimate control and ownership of Samsung Electronics are concentrated in the founding Lee family, currently led by Lee Jae-yong (Jay Y. Lee).
Samsung Electronics operates under the broader umbrella of the Samsung Group, linked through a web of cross-shareholdings involving affiliates like Samsung C&T and Samsung Life Insurance.
The family of the late founder Lee Byung-chul maintains controlling influence over the entire corporate empire.
Lee Jae-yong, the grandson of the founder, serves as the chairman and de facto head of the group.
Samsung Electronics is a publicly traded, multinational corporation with shares owned by global institutional investors and the public.
Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. was established in 1969 and is headquartered in Suwon, South Korea.
Samsung Electronics is a major global manufacturer of consumer electronics and semiconductors.
